overview: This Senate resolution recognizes November 3 through November 7, 2025, as National Veterans Small Business Week. It notes that military service builds skills useful in running a business and that veterans own more than 1.6 million small businesses employing millions of people. It supports the goals of the week, which the Small Business Administration also marks with events, calls for policies that keep regulations from burdening small business owners, and thanks veterans for continuing to serve the country through entrepreneurship. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on November 4, 2025. It is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
for: Supporters say the resolution honors veterans who start businesses and create jobs after their military service.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not give veteran business owners any new resources or support.
